name: Family restaurant
description: Mom-and-pop family restaurant, 18 x 12 m: timber-clad and rendered single storey with fabric awnings over the dining-room windows, a blank sign panel over the entrance, a parapet roof with an extract fan and air-conditioning plant. Enterable: restrooms with cubicles, a dining room with its own street door, a bar room with a fixed bar counter, stools and back bar, and a commercial kitchen with a cooking line under a stainless hood, a prep island and a back door.
